properties.note: Gas-phase ion-dipole pre-reaction complex BH4-...H2C=O. This log is the Opt+Freq (B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, Tight/UltraFine) started directly from the canonical reactant-side IRC outer frame: 0 imaginary frequencies, 2 fragments, B...O ~4.4 A, B...C ~3.3 A. An independent five-orientation conformer search (work/minima/) found the same single minimum at -141.672770821 Ha.

Exactly one imaginary frequency, -875.36 cm-1 (B-H stretch / H migration along the three-centre B-H-C unit; mode aligned with the reaction centre). Late, product-like saddle: B...H 1.929, H...C 1.179, B...O 2.555, C-O 1.306 A.
Borane-methoxide adduct CH3O-BH3-; Opt+Freq from the canonical product-side IRC outer frame, 0 imaginary frequencies (B-O 1.49, C-O 1.37, B-O-C 115 deg).

edges.channel: single concerted (strongly nonsynchronous) hydride transfer from BH4- to the carbonyl C with simultaneous B-O bond formation to the methoxide O
